cases.name: frame mismatch
cases.why: the terrain and the layout must declare the identical horizontal frame; no transformation is attempted

cases.name: vertical datum mismatch
cases.change: surface.vertical = {kind: orthometric, crs: EPSG:5703} and request.vertical.expected_crs = EPSG:5773
cases.why: no vertical transformation in Module 02 (PROJ falls back to a no-op ballpark transformation offline; see research/library-probes.json)

cases.name: missing vertical datum
cases.why: elevations without a declared vertical reference are not accepted

cases.name: source mismatch
cases.why: a placement names the layout by result_id and payload_digest together

cases.name: overlapping triangles
cases.why: a 2.5D surface maps each plan point to one elevation

cases.name: clockwise triangle
cases.why: orientation is part of the contract (counter-clockwise in plan)

cases.name: duplicate plan vertex
cases.why: two elevations at one plan point

cases.name: cracked T-junction
cases.change: hill-fan: append vertex 5 = (6, 2, 10.5) on edge (8,0)-(4,4) and replace triangle [1, 2, 4] by [1, 2, 5] and [5, 2, 4]; triangle [0, 1, 4] keeps the full edge
cases.why: the edge interpolates to 10.3 at (6, 2) on one side and the new vertex says 10.5: a crack with two elevations along one line

cases.name: support outside footprint
cases.why: supports are inside the table footprint

cases.name: unsupported policy
cases.why: reorientation is a later, separately approved milestone

accepted_variants.name: consistent T-junction
accepted_variants.change: as 'cracked T-junction' but with vertex 5 = (6, 2, 10.3), the edge's interpolated elevation
accepted_variants.expected: valid surface; T03 placement unchanged (L = 11.1 m)
